freshResearch.method: Separate first-party web discovery in English and French; actual result URLs recorded. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe property lookup, or TLS-disable action used.

registryEvidence.custodian: Direction générale des Domaines et du Cadastre du Mali (DGDC), with DRDC/SEGOU listed in the official regional-services directory.
registryEvidence.localEvidence: The official directory lists DRDC/SEGOU and phone 21 32 26 48; this establishes a local/regional cadastral custodian route, not an open parcel API.

notes: NINACAD reporting names Ségou among cities covered by an addressing initiative, but no anonymous parcel geometry or public map/API endpoint was verified. Packet is research evidence only; no source integration or runtime admission.
